title: Super Mario Mash-Up: Calico Cat Addition
description: This pack adds the Calico cat from Super Mario 3D World + Bowser’s Fury replacing the "Jellie" cat texture, which was not changed at all in the original Super Mario Mash-Up pack.
body:
![Calico Cats Logo!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab6c3211cd97b0870d5f94ab3ba769dbfd9caf8e_0.webp)This pack adds the cat from Super Mario 3D World + Bowser’s Fury replacing the "Jellie" cat texture, which was not changed at all in the original Super Mario Mash-Up pack so i just wanted to make this Mash-Up even more completed, also this cat has a baby form!![Calico Cats Logo!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b6205f61f4b0dc8768d44cb35a3f525ad40aea2.webp) 
Recommendation: For the ultimate experience, i highly recommend using this texture alongside the official Super Mario Mash-Up Pack to make this Calico cat fit seamlessly into your world.
Original Textures & Inspiration: Full credits to 4J Studios for their incredible work on the original Super Mario Mash-Up Pack textures and chillyroll for porting the original package to the Java version.
Note: It is likely that this texture wasn't changed in the original Mash-Up because it is based on Jellie—a cat belonging to the YouTuber GoodTimesWithScar, who passed away a few years ago. Although the cat was already in the game prior to that, I want to clarify that I have nothing against this inclusion; in fact, I love it and find it truly charming. (I also want to mention that this calico cat feels very familiar to me, as my grandparents once had a cat of the same breed—"I hope you're doing well up there, Mimi.")
With that said, enjoy!
